summary: Flathead County, MT lookout site on the Flathead NF; firelookout.com dates an L-4 cab to 1932 and its destruction to 1960; listed as gone; no staffing or fire history found.

facts.status_note: Ground lookout listed as gone (Forest Fire Lookout Association list); no source describes what remains

events.note: L-4 cab mid-slope between Canyon Creek and Clorinda Creek, per firelookout.com

evidence.supports: location: 18 miles southeast of Hungry Horse, Flathead County, Montana
county and forest: Flathead County, Flathead National Forest
built 1932 as an L-4 cab mid-slope between Canyon Creek and Clorinda Creek; destroyed 1960
evidence.quote: 1932: L-4 cab mid-slope between Canyon Creek & Clorinda Creek. Destroyed 1960.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts listing: Flathead County, Flathead National Forest, township 29N, range 17W, section 35
ground lookout, coordinates 48.23092 -113.74179, listed as gone

notes_for_editor: Dates and design come only from firelookout.com (one page). The Forest Lookouts page gives the county, forest, township and section. Two web searches found no other account of the cab, its staffing, fires or present state. The record label credits Ron Kemnow for the Forest Lookouts site; the page read does not show that name, so the story does not use it.
